en.title: Cyclically Increment Prefix Letters
en.description:
Each operation cyclically increments the first k lowercase letters once, with z becoming a. Output the string after performing all operations in order.

The input protocol, the ranges added by this site, the examples, and the tests were written independently by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains the string s (1..100000 lowercase letters); the second line contains the number of operations m (1..100000); the third line contains m values of k, with 1≤k≤|s|.
en.explanation:
Example 1: the three prefix operations give bca, cda, dda in turn.

Example 2: z cyclically increments to a.

Example 3: only the first character is incremented, twice, so abc becomes cbc.
hints: Use a difference array to record each prefix increment of 1, scan the prefix sums to get the total number of increments at each position, then take it modulo 26.
